title: Patient Payment Plans Installment Agreement: Acceptance of a Re-Spread Installment
content:
A re-spread of the installment of an active plan under the Patient Payment Plans, whether the patient asks for it or it follows an add-on, changes the patient's payment obligation, so it takes effect only when the patient accepts it in person; the representative prepares the figure and hands the acceptance to the patient.

## Conditions of the re-spread installment

1. The re-spread installment is fixed only after the plan carries an enrollment entry for every charge the financial account posted for an encounter the plan enrolled at its proposal.
2. The re-spread installment is not worked out until the plan balance carries the add-on fee entry owed for every add-on booked on the handling date.
3. The re-spread installment is fixed only after the plan's term shows the extension months the add-on earns.

Put in terms of the records: every charge the Patient Financial Account shows posted to an encounter the plan enrolled at its proposal has its own enrollment entry on the plan; each add-on dated the handling date that owes an add-on fee has that fee entry beside it on the plan balance; and the plan's term already includes the extension months the add-on earns.

## Acceptance: `accept_add_on_installment_27cdd630`

**Capability.** The patient accepts, in their own name, a re-spread monthly installment of their active payment plan, taking on the changed payment obligation. One call records one modification of the plan: the plan's monthly installment becomes the amount given and its modification count grows by one. The plan balance and term are not changed by this call, and no payment is taken.

**Invocation.** This is the patient's own tool. The representative unlocks it for the patient with `unlock_user_discoverable_tool` and hands the acceptance over; the customer themselves, the patient, runs it (`call_user_discoverable_tool`) to accept.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `payment_plan_id` | Reference number of the patient's active payment plan, as read to the patient from the payment plan lookup | Identifier |
| `installment_amount` | The new monthly installment the patient accepts | USD, 2 decimal places, positive; stored exactly as given, rounded half up to 2 decimal places |

**Return.** A confirmation sentence naming the payment plan reference, the new monthly installment in USD with 2 decimal places and the new modification count (an integer). Receiving this sentence means the new installment is in force; the plan lookup then shows it.
